title: Leverage = Tension x Weight x f(Slope)
body: Every high-leverage action sits at the intersection of maximum tension, maximum weight, and an ascending slope. The slope is an amplifier — it multiplies everything downstream.
fires: Any strategic decision, prioritization, resource allocation
counter: When urgency overrides slope — pure tension without trajectory

title: Reciprocation Is Not Mimicry
body: True reciprocation is mutual investment with independent initiative. Mimicry is pattern-matching behavior without autonomous motivation. The difference is detectable — mimicry has latency and requires priming.
fires: Reading relationship dynamics, evaluating partnership quality

title: Process Is Not Living
body: The framework serves the life. When processing substitutes for living — analyzing substitutes for acting, mapping substitutes for moving — the tool has become the trap.
origin: Claude analysis — infinite regress risk flag
fires: When in meta-processing loops exceeding 20 min with no output
counter: Some processing IS the work — strategy, architecture, design

title: Capture First, Filter Never
body: During externalization mode, the filter is disabled. Every fragment, half-thought, and raw signal gets captured. Filtering during capture kills insight. Filter only in integration.
fires: Any recording session, especially unstructured ones
counter: In NOTE-TAKING mode, structured capture is appropriate
